query:
-- Find delegates NOT already booked in slot 8 (for SHL replacement)
SELECT dp.attendeeId, dp.firstName, dp.lastName, dp.company, dp.jobTitle
FROM delegateProfiles dp
WHERE dp.attendeeId NOT IN (
  SELECT attendeeId FROM meetings WHERE timeSlot = 8 AND status IN ('confirmed','suggested')
)
AND dp.attendeeId != '9319401'
ORDER BY dp.lastName;
